answer: Replica skippers fail a one-window night clearance at inlet IN-14. After locking 23.1 POA, the claimant has 35 minutes to complete a voyage ticket VT-82: shoot a 41-minute-arc sextant cut from lamp L-9 onto comet tick CT-04, time a 68-second drift past spar S-3, and punch the ticket with the combined checksum. A second warden re-runs the cut and drift clock from the same marks. Drift over 0.25 minutes of arc, a late punch, or a stamp mismatch burns the 23.1 POA and bars the address for six epochs. The bond is refunded only after a later ticket whose lamp and spar both change.
